about: The game's own words that the addon's lines quote (menu paths and the things to click), in English, from WoW: Forever build 1.60.1.70009's GlobalStrings (wago.tools' GlobalStrings table, read 2026-09-27; id is the row's ID there). The AddOns list's category row menu is ADDON_LIST_ENABLE_CATEGORY, ADDON_LIST_DISABLE_CATEGORY and ADDON_LIST_RESET_ALL_TO_DEFAULT (AddonList.lua:952-961 at wow-ui-source bd2470a); no string on that build reads "Enable All in Category" (C-128).
